newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Seat seen as buy up to 730 lire - broker.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Seat seen as buy up to 730 lire - broker.

text.p: Italy's yellow pages publisher Seat, about to be spun off from telecoms holding group STET, is seen as a "buy" oppportunity up to 730 lire a share, said brokers Actinvest in a research note.
Actinvest has been meeting over the last few days with Seat, which is expected to have its Milan bourse debut in early 1997.
The broker has valued the company at a little under three trillion lire, which values the ordinary shares at 612 lire each and savings shares at 397 lire a share.
Actinvest sees Seat 1996 sales of 2.219 trillion lire, up 2.6 percent on 1995, and then sees further growth of around 3-4 percent in 1997 and 1998.
The brokers sees group net profits of 163 billion lire in 1996, down slightly from 169 billion lire in 1995, but then sees a rise to 179 billion lire in 1997.
